name: Joseph H.
career_history: Senior Estimator at Structure Tone Southwest, 1/2023 to present; Senior Estimating Engineer at JE Dunn Construction, 3/2022 to 1/2023; Estimating Engineer 2 at JE Dunn Construction, 9/2021 to 3/2022; Estimator at Gadberry Construction, 8/2017 to 9/2021; Project Estimator at Brookstone Construction, 9/2015 to 8/2017; Pre Construction/Estimating at Balfour Beatty US, 2/2015 to 9/2015; Field Engineer Intern at Hensel Phelps, 5/2014 to 9/2014; Project Engineer Intern at Vaughn Construction, 12/2013 to 5/2014; Project Engineer Intern at Linbeck Group, 5/2013 to 11/2013
education: Minor, Business Administration, Management and Operations, University of Houston
biography:
As a Senior Estimator with a strong foundation in both field operations and preconstruction, I bring a unique perspective to every project, one that bridges on-site experience with strategic planning and collaboration. My time on the jobsite has shaped how I approach estimating: with precision, practicality, and a deep respect for the people and processes that bring a project to life.

Developing lasting relationships with clients, architects, and trade partners across the industry is at the forefront of my focus. I believe in a client-first approach, and I’m committed to working closely with all stakeholders to align vision, budget, and execution. 

My project experience spans several key sectors, including:
• Building Repositioning
• Ground-Up
• Healthcare 
• Industrial 
• Aviation
• Mission Critical Environments

Collaboration, transparency, and integrity are at the core of how I approach every opportunity.
